name: CNN Town Hall
summary: Discussing topics of interest to U.S. viewers.

previousepisode.name: War With Iran: A CNN Town Hall

name: State of the Race
summary: CNN's top correspondents guide viewers through the key political players, the cultural issues, and the mechanics of America's unique electoral process.

name: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
summary: Based on the series by acclaimed Christian novelist Stephen R. Lawhead, The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin is a unique retelling of the Arthurian legend, not set in the Medieval age of knights in shining armor, but in an earlier time — the end of Roman Britain when pagan tribes warred with Saxon and Pict invaders, and with each other, and the idea of a unified Britain was only a dream. In this tumultuous world Merlin, the son of an Atlantean princess and the bard, Taliesen, pursues his father's vision of a Kingdom of Summer — a Britain unified in peace. But to achieve this dream, Merlin will have to overcome ancient evils and navigate both the fall of the Roman occupation and the rise of Christianity in search of a king who can unite the Island of the Mighty.

name: Night Has Come
summary: A mystery teen drama that takes place when a class of second-year high school students is suddenly forced to play mafia games in real life during their retreat.

name: Countdown to Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
summary: On the eve of the iconic Thanksgiving Day parade, viewers get a behind-the-scenes peek at the incredible stories behind the floats, balloons and bands on their journey to the streets of New York.

previousepisode.name: 2025 Countdown to Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade

name: Mei Fu You Nv Chu Zhang Cheng
Allegiance
summary: Allegiance follows on identity and belonging, policing and politics, and finding truth within the heart of a flawed justice system. Sabrina Sohal is a star rookie police officer who must grapple with the limits of the justice system as she fights to exonerate her politician father Ajeet Sohal. Sohal serves her diverse hometown of Surrey alongside Vince Brambilla, a veteran training officer who sees her potential but doesn't always agree with her forward-thinking methods. Allegiance is the story of a young woman caught between her allegiance to her flag, to her badge, and to her family.

name: Smothered
summary:
Will they? Won't they? Should they? Shouldn't they?

Smothered, is a not so typical rom-com. A tale of two worlds colliding, where romance blossoms but the pressures of modern dating linger.

name: Bad Surgeon: Love Under the Knife
summary: Dr. Paolo Macchiarini is world famous for his revolutionary stem cell-infused windpipe transplants. There's just one problem: His patients keep dying.

name: Chrissy & Dave Dine Out
summary: Chrissy & Dave Dine Out will take viewers to must-try restaurants in Los Angeles that are unexpected and, at times, off the beaten path. While David gets his hands dirty in the back of house with the restaurant's chef, Chrissy and Joel will hold court in the front of house, hosting an always loose, unexpected and entertaining dinner party with undeniably delicious food and great conversation. Celebrity guests handpicked by Chrissy, David and Joel will bring laughs and unfiltered conversations, where no topic is off limits.

name: On the Fly: Adventures at Altitude
summary: Follow regular people as they turn their curiosity, excitement and love of the skies into extraordinary feats of aviation.

name: Top Combat Pilot
summary: Dennis Quaid takes us inside the most elite aviation program in America. Known as WTI, the Marine's version of Top Gun invites the best of the best combat pilots from every squadron in the country to prove their mettle. All are out to perfect their specialty, operating an unrivaled air fleet including F-18 Hornets, Huey, and Cobra Combat helicopters. The pilots who distinguish themselves earn a coveted invitation to return as an instructor…while those who slip up might not graduate at all.

name: Murder in Boston: Roots, Rampage, and Reckoning
summary:
On October 23, 1989, Charles "Chuck" Stuart places a frantic 911 call reporting that he and his pregnant wife, Carol, a white couple, have been shot by a Black man in Boston's Mission Hill neighborhood. The ensuing investigation proves to be a lightning rod for the city, igniting decades-old racial tensions and brutal targeting amidst a media firestorm.

After Carol succumbs to her injuries that night, Boston mayor Raymond Flynn declares a citywide manhunt for the killer.  When Carol and Chuck's baby also dies just days after being born, the homicides are thrust further into the spotlight. As the mostly Black and Latino residents of Boston's Mission Hill neighborhood suffer aggressive raids, "stop and frisk" searches, and some questionable police tactics, the already fraught relationship between residents and Boston Police disintegrates. Fanned by the media uproar and simmering tensions, and with skepticism from the Black community and some members of the press about the veracity of Chuck's story, the police face increasing pressure to solve the case and Boston is transformed into a powder keg as the quest for an arrest reaches a critical juncture.

name: Гость у порога
summary: A culinary show in which four reality contestants compete for the title of best home cook and chef. We'll find out who wins at the table!

name: Qi Hou Bilu
summary: When the Epang Palace was burned to the ground two thousand years ago, the School of Naturalists' ancestors lamented that Qin Shihuang had degraded Confucians and burned books, saying that "if you don't teach the world, all the talents will be wasted." When the literati died, he started to concentrate their souls. To ensure that his skills are passed down to future generations, finish the Chinese brush. A normal college student named Luo Zhongxia accidently acquired Li Bai's Qinglian posthumous Chinese brush two thousand years later, and ever then, he has held the superpowers provided by the brush spirit. The happy times did not endure, however, as other forces were drawn to the potent influence of Qinglian's works, which frequently put Luo Zhongxia in danger. Luo Zhongxia dedicated himself to finding a way to retract his essay in order to prevent conflicts, but he kept running across roadblocks. He instead developed a strong bond with the "Seven Lords in charge of the city".

previousepisode.name: My Love for You Is Steadfast as Mountains

name: Les Espions de la terreur
summary: The hunt for those responsible for the November 2015 attacks is putting the French secret services under great strain. Among them, Lucie, an experienced and determined DGSI anti-terrorist agent, fights to advance the investigation. She joins forces with Malika, a seasoned analyst from the DGSE. The limitless commitment of these anonymous heroes, ready to do anything to protect France from new attacks, will undermine their private lives and awaken deep scars.

name: Here Comes Your Man
summary: Two very different young men come together in a show that follows their relationship, from beginning to end.

name: Oshi ga Joshi ni Narimashite
summary:
Nakajo Hitomi works as an OL and she is huge fan of stage actor Kiryu Toma. Her big joy in life is to watch him perform in stage plays, but she has been recently feeling down because of Toma's sudden retirement from acting. One day, she meets her new boss Takagi Shuichi. Surprisingly, her new boss is the retired stage actor Kiryu Toma, but using his birth name. After his retirement, he began to work at the company in which his father runs and where Hitomi works. He becomes popular with the female employees at the company and he behaves sweetly to all of them. Hitomi wants to talk to him like the other female employees, but, when she gets the chance, she panics and gives him a cold reaction. Shuichi becomes interested in Hitomi, who seems different from the other female employees.

Season 2 doesn't continue on season 1 but instead does a parallel scenario.

name: Secret Playlist
summary: Han Joo is your ordinary university student… except for the fact that she's also the up-and-coming Metube cover artist, PLII. When popular boy group member Levi takes notice of PLII and requests to collaborate, Han Joo will do anything to hide her secret identity. But as the two grow closer working on a class project, Han Joo's cover begins to unravel. Will Levi discover her secret?

name: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom: Protecting the Wild
summary: Renowned wildlife experts explore the work of conservationists helping to save imperiled species.

previousepisode.name: Héliogabale, le plus mauvais farceur de l'histoire

name: The Origin: Madam Koi-Koi
summary: A vengeful spirit stalks an isolated college, drawn by the school's grim history of sexual violence and one student's mysterious ties to the past.

name: Lackadaisy
summary: Lackadaisy is based on the webcomic created by American artist, Tracy J. Butler. Set in a Prohibition-era St. Louis with a population of anthropomorphic cats.

name: Tudse og Venner
summary: Children cartoon based on the Danish author 'Kenneth Grahams' work 'Vinden i Piletræerne' (The wind blows in the trees).

name: Decision 2024
summary: Analysis of the Republican National Committee debates in the 2024 election cycle.

name: Соседка
summary:
Thirty-five-year-old Fyodor Sadovsky is a modest director of a cleaning company, in whose life there has long been no place for new people, let alone exploits. For the past few years, his only entertainment has been chess tournaments with his best friend Borya and work. At the same time, on the house where Fyodor lives, there is a memorial plaque in memory of his father - the famous Soviet cosmonaut, in the shadow of whose glory Fyodor has lived since childhood.

Everything changes when Alyona, a girl from Salsk who knows no boundaries - neither personal nor communal - moves into the apartment opposite. At first glance, there is nothing in common between them, but unbeknownst to himself, Fyodor falls in love. However, the situation is aggravated by the presence of Alena's ex-husband, a jealous widower of Serega.

name: Mysteries From Above
summary: Investigate significant historic and contemporary sites from the revealing vantage points of drone, satellite, and aerial photography. Each episode contains four distinct stories, and each story begins with a view from above, allowing for a unique perspective from which to understand the site below, dramatically changing the way we see ourselves and the world around us.

name: Isadora Moon
summary: Isadora Moon, adapted from author and illustrator Harriet Muncaster's international best-selling book series, is a series full of humour, heart and magical adventures. Enchanted and human worlds collide as 8-year-old half-fairy half-vampire, Isadora Moon, chooses to go to human school, navigating all sorts of adventures with her friends.

name: Inside M&S
summary: Filmed over a year and with unprecedented access, for the first time, cameras have been invited inside every corner of M&S - from the build of a multi-million-pound store to top secret development kitchens at HQ.

name: Junior Doctors Down Under
summary: Every year hundreds of junior doctors are lured Down Under to work where they've never worked before: The Emergency Department.

name: The Mountain Kitchen
summary: For Annie Starke, it's all about great eats and good times as she prepares delicious meals indoors and over the fire at her family's mountain ranch in Montana.

previousepisode.name: Cowboy Cookout for a City Guy

name: Escaping Twin Flames
summary: A couple lured romantic hopefuls with promises of a soulmate and pressured them to conform to their beliefs. Now, their shocking practices are revealed.

name: Últimas Férias
summary: At the end of a year full of competitions, a group of young athletes decides to spend their last vacation together on an island paradise. Far from their families and isolated from the world, it seemed like the perfect trip. But when the body of one of them is found lifeless in the sea, friendships are tested and secrets come to light in a breathtaking thriller where each and every one is a suspect.

name: Lockerbie
summary:
Lockerbie tells the incredible true story of Britain's deadliest terrorist atrocity and the most fatal terrorist attack on America before 9/11: the bombing of Pan Am flight 103, when 270 people lost their lives on the night of December 21 1988.  

The documentary will speak to individuals closely linked to the disaster and the years-long investigation that followed it.  With access to victims' families, investigators, intelligence officers and other key figures who have not spoken until now, the series will examine unanswered questions and explore the truth behind the atrocity to provide a definitive account of the bombing and its aftermath and - ultimately - who was responsible.

name: Wonderland: Gothic
summary: Wonderland: Gothic combines biography, literary extracts, and interviews with leading academics and film director Tim Burton, together with excerpts from the many books and films made of Gothic work to explore what was behind these well-known Gothic stories.

name: Le Stade, la série
summary: Stade Toulousain, a Rugby Union club with an unrivalled track record, winning titles, the European cup and the Brennus Shield, remains the target.

name: Follow
summary:
The Paris judicial police are investigating a serial killer who drugs his victims before cutting off their thumbs, and who steals their phones to post a final photo on social media after the fact.

Léna, a young intern who works in the communications department of the Paris police headquarters, alerts the judicial police officers after noticing that the account of Capucine de Warren, the most followed influencer in France, has just posted a photo that had already been posted a year earlier. The police rush to the young influencer's home and find her drugged and mutilated like the other victims but still alive.

In order to catch the culprit as quickly as possible, Commissioner Agathe Ruffin takes the risk of integrating Léna into her team in order to benefit from her knowledge of social media. Léna manages to communicate with the killer and get a clue about his next victim, but the ensuing police operation turns into a fiasco and leads to the humiliation of the police on social media.

From being a valuable collaborator, Léna becomes a suspect in the eyes of the commissioner and her police officers.

name: Australian Epic
summary: A musical extravaganza that breathes new life into some of the country's most defining stories, by giving them the full musical treatment they've always deserved.

name: Date Machine
summary: After years of research, science has created the most efficient machine for finding love. And your favorite reality series stars intend to take advantage of it to improve their love lives.

name: The New Adventures of Ocean Girl
summary: On the planet of Oceana there were four life giving crystals guarded by the Sacred Whales, the keepers of wisdom. Thousands of years ago Galiel, the evil space wizard, stole one of the crystals and upset the balance of nature. Now Neri, Princess of Oceana, must search for the crystal and restore the balance of nature.

name: C'est arrivé près de chez vous
summary: Travel to eight Québec communities that have been forever marked by homicides. Each episode will feature individuals who have been affected by an unusual crime and will try to understand what happened: what motivates an individual to do the horrific deed, to take the life of a stranger, an acquaintance, a friend, a family member?

previousepisode.name: Trahir les mots pour salir les morts

name: Me Contro Te — La Famiglia Reale
IXE-13 et la course à l'uranium
summary: IXE-13 – code name of agent Jean Thibault (Marc-André Grondin) – returns to service to face a double threat: that of the Russians who are looking for uranium to create a bomb and that of a Nazi group seeking the same thing to conquer the world.

name: Mercato
summary: Thomas Chevalier, an office cop with an exemplary career to date, happens to be at the airport at the time of the historic arrival of OM's new star recruit to France, when he is forced to intervene to neutralize a madman who is about to attack the footballer. Unwittingly, he injures the player, putting an end to the Marseille dream before it has even begun...

name: Culte
summary:
Season 1: In 2001, Isabelle, Raphaël, Karim, and their teams had less than four months to get a new show on the air: Loft Story, a French remake of the Big Brother format. In France, they are the first ones to produce a ‘reality TV' show and have to invent everything from scratch. Culte is a fictional series inspired by real events.

Season 2: Longjumeau, 1996. Filip, Adel, and Frank, lifelong best friends, dream of breaking through the walls of their suburban town. Will they manage to survive their dream and remain faithful to their friendship?

name: Extreme China
summary: Adventurers from around the world team up with Chinese explorers to navigate China's extreme landscapes, and learn about the people who call them home.

previousepisode.name: Cave Diving in an Underwater World - Du'an

name: Frozen Surface
summary: Guan Yu, who was a soldier, has a meticulous mind, rigorous style, and extremely hard physical and mental quality. He has solved numerous major and small cases. From a simple and fierce little white criminal policeman, he has grown all the way to a wise and experienced Lanhe County Criminal Police Team Captain. Guan Yu's physical condition went from bad to worse after being promoted to captain of the criminal police. After the 1223 major case, Guan Yu was faced with danger. Under the pressure of time, pressure from superiors, and the loss of relatives and comrades in arms, the black hand of evil is still hidden under the glacier. In the face of this case with many intertwined and implicated cases, can Guan Yu hold high the light of justice and the fire of hope in his hands?

name: Under Pressure: The U.S. Women's World Cup Team
summary: In this docuseries, the U.S. women's national soccer team pursues their third consecutive title amid trials and triumphs at the 2023 FIFA World Cup.

name: Love Has Won: The Cult of Mother God
summary: Love Has Won: The Cult of Mother God chronicles the life and death of Amy Carlson, also known as "Mother God," a self-proclaimed spiritual savior who promised an escape from the "3D" world via her online manifestos and live-streaming sessions. As her most fervent acolytes came to live with Amy, they cared for "Mother God," whose health gradually declined. Amy's followers joined her in believing that her physical demise was the result of her taking on the pain of the world, and that her deterioration would ultimately lead to her evacuation by UFO and salvation for humanity. Told through the eyes of Amy's devotees, both former and still practicing, and constructed almost entirely from the cult's archival footage, the series captures the early boom of internet proselytizing and the perils of a conspiracy-driven faith.

name: Ingen elsker Bamsegutt
summary: A cry for help leads Tore Strømøy to the Philippines, where disabled Bamsegutt ran aground more than ten years ago.

name: Gitt bort
summary: Christian Strand was just a baby when he was adopted from Indonesia. He fears the truth about his own background and has never looked into it. Until now.

previousepisode.name: Til fjells med Lindmo og Brimi

name: Asbjørns julekalender
summary: There are few people who love Christmas as much as Asbjørn Brekke. Every evening, an expectant Asbjørn opens the door to his small Christmas workshop for a new celebrity guest and perhaps a new friend.

name: Ross Kemp: Mafia and Britain
summary:
Actor and documentarian Ross Kemp will be investigating and exposing Britain's surprising and deep-rooted links with the mafia, dating as far back as the 1920s. It's always been assumed that Britain has had no links to the world's most infamous organised crime organisation, but the truth – as Ross will discover and as recent arrests of mafiosi in the UK reveal - is far more sinister and complex. Since the UK does not recognise membership of the mafia as a crime, it has at various points in history become a safe haven for mafia ‘Cosa nostra' lieutenants, ‘soldiers' and hit men who have hidden all over the UK in locations as unlikely as caravan parks and newsagents. 

In this series Ross will start his journey in London, taking us back to 1982, where the body of the so-called ‘God's Banker', Roberto Calvi, was discovered under Blackfriars Bridge with his pockets stuffed full of foreign currency from all over the world. From there Ross will embark on an epic odyssey to New York, Italy, Sicily, Colombia and Spain, before arriving back in London, to reveal the intricate path of the mafia's involvement with Britain over nearly a century. 

On his travels, Ross will be speaking with those closest to mafia bosses, top organised crime investigators, and some who have been affected by their crimes. Ross will use this knowledge to trace the complex network of money, drugs, and criminals, in and out of the UK, creating a historical map and timeline to reveal how the mafia has quietly and effectively inveigled its way into the heart of Britain's underworld.

name: In My Own Words
summary: A series of films made up of intimate first-person testimony, mixed with archive and actuality. In My Own Words will take viewers closer than ever before to major creative figures, delivering great arts stories combined with real psychological revelation.

name: Sahara-sensei to Toki-kun
summary: Problem student Toki Kaneda seems to be a troublemaker, but he has an innocent nature despite it all. His day-to-day life changes completely when he meets his PE teacher, Ichiro Sahara, who even becomes his motivation to go to school! A somewhat awkward but sincere teacher-student romance is about to begin!

name: Return to Paradise
summary: DI Mackenzie Clarke was meant to be back in the UK, living the life she's always wanted. Instead, she's still in Dolphin Cove. Lucky for Mack, her compulsion to solve impossible cases serves as a great distraction.

name: Club Friday Season 15: Love Begins
summary: The relationship between two families begins with the friendship of one's daughter and the other's son. As time goes on, Namkhing and Foon's friendship morphs into first love. Spending increased time together, they eventually have the cahnce to take a family trip together. Soon, the relationship between Namkhing's mother Chayanut and Foon's father Sahat crosses a line. Both families are shaken by the realisation that Chayanut and Sahat had had an affari resulting in a pregnancy. Despite it all, the couples chose to stay by each other so as not to break up their families.

name: Radiradirah
summary: An all-star team of Kiwi talent contributed to this sketch comedy — including Taika Waititi, Rhys Darby, the bro'Town team, and 'special guest stars' Jemaine Clement and John Clarke. In-between one-off and ongoing sketches, there were regular appearances by Taika Waititi as an oddball alien character with plans for planet Earth. There were also animated inserts like laconic sheep tale The Pen, FOT (Funny Orange Thing) and the Kiwi accents of Beached Az. Eight episodes screened on TV3. Bro'Town creator Elizabeth Mitchell was producer and lead director.

name: Love Senior
summary: The story of Manao, the brand-new freshie, who accidentally falls for Gyoza's words, the naughty head senior, and must be a representative of the branch to compete in the Freshy contest. A chaotic story ensues when the head senior, who everyone considers evil, is so cute that the junior's heart misses a beat.

previousepisode.name: Fairy of the Deep Darkness - Act Three

name: Fight Inc: Inside the UFC
summary:
Fight Inc: Inside the UFC will provide fans with unprecedented access to UFC CEO Dana White and his team as they peel back the curtain for a look at the daily grind and endless problem-solving in the fight business, including rebuilding fight cards on the fly for major events. The series will also chronicle key storylines featuring the biggest stars in UFC, highlighted by:

· The G.O.A.T, former UFC Light Heavyweight Champion Jon Jones, as he prepares to return after a three-year hiatus to face the weight of expectations and the demons of doubt.

· The emergence of Sean O'Malley, who's fighting for the bantamweight title and the chance to become the next UFC superstar.

· Israel Adesanya and Alexander Volkanovski, both teammates and champions who dare to be great, with mixed results.

· The greatest female fighter ever, Amanda Nunes, as she headlines an event fraught with challenges for the UFC team.

name: Austin
summary: When much-loved children's author Julian Hartswood inadvertently causes a social media storm, his career and that of his illustrator wife Ingrid appears to be over. That is until Austin, the neurodivergent son that Julian never knew existed, turns up out of the blue. Could embracing this modern nuclear family be Julian's route back from cancellation? Will Ingrid forgive him for being such a pompous shit? One thing is for certain: if Julian thinks Austin is going to be a push over, he's in for a rude awakening.

name: Cinta Fitri
summary: Fitri has just moved to Jakarta; alone and struggling with surviving. Blunt yet kindhearted, Fitri charms Farel, a young businessman who slowly falling for her; despite a lot of the judgments.

name: Big Brother Reindeer Games
summary: A holly jolly showdown of Big Brother Legends is coming to CBS in the hit reality show's first holiday special.

name: Føkkings Fladseth
summary: Life is smiling for stand-up comedian Henrik Fladseth, but everything is in danger of unraveling when he is accused of having "blackfaced" himself at a nachspiel.

name: La Une
summary: An observation series that takes us into the world of journalism. Observe as journalists as they put body and soul into their quest for truth and justice.

name: The Drive
summary: A makeshift family of five roommates struggle to carve their own path while living on Vancouver's eclectic, diverse and unpredictable Commercial Drive.

name: The Story Keepers
summary: The Story Keepers is an animated Christian video series that tells the story of a Christian leader and his family's adventures living in Ancient Rome, Italy whose mission is to keep Jesus's stories alive during the 1st century. Introduction: Rome, 64 AD. The Emperor Nero has unleashed his fury against the Christians. Their crime: Proclaiming a King higher than Caesar. Setting fire to the city, Nero places the blame on the Christians, and launches a new campaign to wipe them out. Families are separated, children left homeless, as thousands are sold into slavery or thrown to the lions. Escaping the panic of the fire, and dodging the advancing soldiers, a group of children find shelter in the gentle care of Ben and Helena; a local baker, and his wife. Here the children discover an amazing secret network of daring men and women, who risk their lives to help one another, and to tell the stories of the great storyteller, the one called Jesus. And so awaiting the day when their parents will return, Anna, Cyrus, Justin, and Marcus, embark on an adventure of a lifetime, together with Ben, Helena, and their friends, in the Christian underground. Their mission: To keep the stories of Jesus alive. This is their story. They are the Story Keepers!

name: Døm vores forhold
summary:
Are we better at guiding other pairs of relationsship, than our own?

In this serie unknown couples moves into where other couples lives, and guides on their relationship, with the help of the host 'Anna Lin'.

name: Bae Beyond Borders
summary: Four single South African ladies are on a quest to find love in Nigeria. During the first round of dating, Southie babes jump on online dates with 12 Nigerian bachelors.

previousepisode.name: A Love Crossroads: Who will lock in?

name: Kontant
summary:
This recurring documentary that touches on current subjects thats on mind on the Danish population. 

Program works on the premise that population/consumers, sends in subjects to dwell into, that they mean is of public interest. 

The staff of the show, then chooses the subjects that is most relevant for a investigation.

name: Playing Go
summary: "Playing Go" is set in a southern Chinese city during the early 21st century. It follows Cui Ye, an ordinary Go teacher whose life spirals into chaos after an accidental entanglement in a crime. As he gradually descends into a life of illegality, he becomes relentlessly pursued by his police officer brother, Cui Wei. The story paints a gripping tale of two brothers on opposite sides of the law.

name: How to Fail as a Popstar
summary: In order to become a popstar, a queer brown boy with a huge voice is doing everything he can. Told by the queer trans femme that boy becomes, looking back on how and why that dream was never realized.

name: Let Us Prey: A Ministry of Scandals
summary:
Let Us Prey: A Ministry of Scandals a new four-part docuseries exposing the predatory and insidious behavior within Independent Fundamental Baptist (IFB) Churches, and the struggles of survivors to find justice. Featuring first-hand accounts from survivors, church defectors and activists, Let Us Prey offers crucial insight into the troubling culture within the IFB and the stronghold the churches have on its members. 

Since its inception in the 1950s, the IFB has evolved into one of the dominant religious forces in the United States today with an estimated 8 million believers spread out over 6,000 churches across the country. Let Us Prey uncovers the dark innerworkings behind the IFB's cheery and virtuous exterior by exposing depraved secrets and violence that have existed within their churches for decades. Rituals oriented towards "breaking a child's will," mind control and torture are only the tip of the iceberg. Below the surface lurks accusations of rape and physical abuse of members, including minors, at the hands of IFB figure heads.

name: The Embers
summary: A tragic massacre in their childhood completely changed the fate of the Liao brothers. Will they break through the darkness for self-redemption, or will they descend into the abyss of vengeance? Once inseparable and solving countless mysterious cases together, the two brothers now stand on opposite sides.

name: Drömträdgården
summary: We follow Swedes all over the country who make their wildest garden dreams come true.

name: Kriminalarkivet Ståplats I Nybroviken
summary: The expression "Ståplats i Nybroviken" has its origins in a well-known triple murder from the 1960s, the so-called "Träskmorden". At that time, a lot is changing in Sweden, drugs are taking hold and crime is becoming increasingly brutal. The perpetrator Hans "Tuppen" Marmbo's name sells loose numbers and scares readers. If you want to look for the roots of what is happening today, then you can go to this era when organized crime began to establish itself in the Swedish public housing.

name: I brottets spår Fallet Tove
summary: For almost a year, SVT's crime reporters Karin Fagerlund and Lasse Lampers have followed the investigation into 20-year-old Tove's death in Vetlanda - from Tove's disappearance to the verdict against two young women in the Court of Appeal. In their search for answers, Karin and Lasse meet investigators, prosecutors and lawyers and review the details of the investigation. They also meet neighbors, acquaintances and others involved to get to the bottom of what really happened and how it affected Vetlanda as a community.

name: En våldsam heder
summary: We follow three authentic cases where people have been severely affected by honor-related violence and oppression, and we gain insight into the mechanisms in an honor context. The series depicts the devastating consequences the standards of honor cause, and the human destinies they leave behind. Experts on issues of honor give us an in-depth picture of honor-related violence and hatred.

name: Min ångest och jag
summary: Anxiety, loneliness, depression and suicidal thoughts are something that many struggle with. Here, four famous Swedes - artist Viktor Frisk, actor Marianne Mörck, former track and field athlete Linus Thörnblad and former handball player Loui Sand - talk openly about their lives. Psychiatrist Anders Hansen deepens the understanding around the protagonists' diagnoses and life situation.

name: Rostmacka
summary: Some of the country's funniest stand-up comedians square off in roast duels, with the goal of destroying their opponent with jokes as their only weapon. A unanimous jury consisting of, among others, Ina Lundström, Jesper Rönndahl and Thanos Fotas chooses the winner of the fight completely arbitrarily. A filter-free program with a sky-high ceiling.

name: Kod Adı Kırlangıç
summary: The common curiosity of children living in the same neighborhood is technology. There are both those who help the children who come together to design drones and the bad guys who try to prevent them... The series will bring the exciting stories of technology-savvy children to the screen

name: Арбатские тайны
summary: April 1959. Tanya Meshcherskaya, who grew up in an orphanage, goes to Moscow to visit her father, academician Vikenty Ryabinsky. She has with her a letter to her father and an old brooch inherited from her mother, which is stolen. Vincent is happy to have a daughter, as he loved her mother, Lilya Meshcherskaya. However, his wife, Maria Pavlovna, takes Tanya with hostility. She is trying to find out details from Vincent's sister, Kisa. Kisa doubts that Vikenty is Tanya's father, and she turns out to be right. But everything turns out too late...

name: The UnBelievable with Dan Aykroyd
summary:
Did you know that a brown bear became a war hero for the Allies during WWII? Or that a flying lawnmower once killed a spectator at a football game? What about the story of the 19th century doctor who ate vomit to understand how yellow fever is transmitted?

If you haven't, then brace yourself for The UnBelievable with Dan Aykroyd.

Each hour-long episode will open up our cabinet of curiosities to reveal the strangest-but-true stories in human history, brought to life through dynamic recreation, compelling graphics, and arresting archival. These seemingly tall tales all actually happened, and our cast of experts dives into the historical record to tell you how and why.

It's a bizarro barrage of people, places and events that prove just how weird our world can be.

name: Deca zla
summary: A masked perpetrator murders a prominent politician and leaves an old, golden coin in his hand. Nikola Bobic, a defence attorney, reluctantly takes a case and plunges into a dangerous game that will change his life forever.

name: Spartacus: House of Ashur
summary: Spartacus: House of Ashur poses the question: What if Ashur hadn't died on Mount Vesuvius at the end of Spartacus: Vengeance? And what if he had been gifted the gladiator school once owned by Batiatus in return for aiding the Romans in killing Spartacus and ending the slave rebellion?

name: Супергерои.ру
summary: The children of a special agent protect a valuable discovery from villains. Futuristic animation about inventive teenagers.

name: Bill Bailey's Australian Adventure
summary: Comedian Bill Bailey explores the vast, epic, extraordinarily beautiful state of Western Australia on a once-in-a-lifetime adventure down under.

name: Hey Dad
summary: Architect Martin Kelly singlehandedly raises his children: Simon, Debbie, and Jenny. His wife, Margaret, had died three years before the series' start. Martin runs his own architectural business from the family home in the Sydney suburb of Chatswood. He employs his wife's cousin[2] Betty Wilson, a good-natured ditz from the New South Wales country town of Walgett, as his secretary. Many episodes deal with the daily stresses Martin faces as the family patriarch, such as settling arguments amongst his children. He frequently endures Betty's elaborate excuses for tardiness and is constantly frustrated with her delayed productivity at work. Simon's best friend is Gerald "Nudge" Noritas,[3] a neighbour who constantly helps himself to whatever food he can find in the Kellys' kitchen. In early episodes, the show briefly examines how the characters are struggling to deal with the absence of Margaret from their lives. Martin also breaks the fourth wall several times to deliver sarcastic one-liners to camera, although this is discontinued after the first 12 episodes

name: Secrets of the Aquarium
summary: Transporting turtles, hugging fish and swimming with sharks - all in a day's work. Head under the water as the dedicated team reveal the secrets of Britain's biggest aquarium.

previousepisode.name: Florence the Shark Is Looking Round

name: Celebrity Big Brother
summary:
Celebrity Big Brother will see a new cast of famous faces isolated from the outside world as they embark on the ultimate social experiment, taking up residence in the iconic Big Brother house. 

Leaving luxury behind, the celebrities will take part in weekly nominations and tough tasks with cameras capturing their every move. Who will win the hearts of the nation, go all the way to the finish line and be crowned the winner?

name: Celebrity Big Brother: Late & Live
summary: Celebrity Big Brother: Late & Live will once again be the only place to watch the famous evictees first live interview alongside an array of unmissable exclusive features including access to the camera runs, special guest commentary and debate.

name: Celebrity Big Brother: Live Stream
summary: The Celebrity Big Brother: Live Stream will also return to screens, airing seven nights a week on ITVX and STV Player, giving fans the opportunity to watch live footage into the small hours after Celebrity Big Brother: Late & Live.

name: Battle Pope
summary:
Battle Pope is an independent superhero comedy comic book series created by Robert Kirkman and Tony Moore, which was published by their own small press company under the moniker of Funk-O-Tron originally in 2000. The series was reprinted in color by Image Comics in 2005, with plans to possibly continue it with new stories after collecting the original material.

The comic was adapted into a season of eight animated webisodes that appeared on Spike TV's website in 2008.[1]

name: Davos 1917
summary: The First World War is ravaging Europe. By contrast, Davos, the noble spa town in the Swiss Alps, seems like an oasis of peace. But behind the scenes, neutral Switzerland takes centre stage in a relentless battle between the secret agents of the world powers. The young nurse Johanna Gabathuler unexpectedly gets caught between the fronts of the spies: to win back her daughter, she gets involved in a deadly game with the German Secret Service – and suddenly becomes the tip of the scales in a risky plan that decides between war and peace.

name: The Count of Monte Cristo
summary: Edmond Dantes, a nineteen-year-old sailor was falsely accused of treason and is imprisoned without trial in the Château d'If, a grim island fortress off Marseille. After many years of captivity he finally escapes and, under the identity of the Count of Monte Cristo, he plans to take revenge on those who have wrongly accused him.

name: Karma
summary: A fateful accident intertwines six lives in a thrilling tale of karma and crime, where each must face their own dark truths and connections. A hit-and-run. A cover-up. A debt-fueled murder plot. Karma weaves together the fates of six characters, each bound by a single, irreversible moment. The Witness observed a mysterious accident in the dead of night, setting the Unspoken Fate in motion. The Surgeon, haunted by a lifelong trauma, and confronted by the painful past she vowed never to face again. The Debtor & the Outsider, jobless and trapped, plunge headlong into the fate of dark deals. The Doctor & the Alluring Girlfriend, as one fateful mistake on a dark night spirals uncontrollably into a catastrophic accident. Six lives, one inescapable fate.

name: Big Brother Uncut
summary:
One of the raunchiest shows in Australian television history in making return, some 17 years after it was yanked from the airwaves.

Big Brother Uncut is the adults-only companion show of the reality show Big Brother Australia.

name: Virgin
summary: When 22-year-old virgin Ellie falls in love with Olivier, her roommates Kira and Veronique convince her to gain some sexual experience before sleeping with him for the first time. Under their guidance, Ellie soon masters the art of seduction in the age of Tinder, free porn and sexual fluidity. But will it all backfire?

name: The Garden Hustle
summary:
The Garden Hustle will be hosted by Australian actress Lisa McCune and garden landscaper, The Block's Dave Franklin (along with resident pooch Robin).

This series will follow everyday homeowners and renters on their journey to create their very own garden oasis. 

Always aspirational and achievable, every makeover featured will be carried out by the occupants themselves as they hustle to turn their tired spaces into a green oasis. This homegrown production full of heart and humour will become a feel-good gardening fix with plenty of genius garden timesavers for viewers to try.

name: The Great Art Fraud
summary: Inigo Philbrick is an art-world sensation, a wunderkind who makes millions selling to the world's richest collectors. But he is also harbouring a dark secret - one that will lead him to the South Pacific in a global game of cat-and-mouse with the FBI.

name: My Dead Mom
summary: Emmy's mother died and she hates what she's wearing. Emmy knows she could live her best life, if her dead mother would JUST. STOP. TALKING. Fern pops into Emmy's life to question her lipstick and life choices, as only a mother can. Even death can't stop Fern from being fabulous… and disappointed. Sure, Emmy would've liked to hike the Appalachian Trail after her mom died, but work's been really busy. She wants to make peace with her mother, move to the other side of grief, but how do you get over someone who is so present?

name: Celebrity Escape to the Country
summary:
Celebrity Escape to the Country welcomes an exciting host of well-known faces hoping to make a countryside relocation including the nation's favourite panto dame and King of the Jungle, Christopher Biggins; Bucks Fizz popstar, Cheryl Baker; TV health professional, Doctor Ranj Singh; Strictly Come Dancing's Janette Manrara and Aljaž Škorjanec; and TV quiz sensation, Jenny Ryan AKA ‘The Vixen' from The Chase.

First launching in 2002, the BBC's longest running property show Escape to the Country has showcased an idyllic look into rural Britain's property market, giving urban homeowners an insight into a prospective country life. Guided by the property experts, the buyers decide whether or not to swap the hustle and bustle of city living in favour of the slower quietude of the countryside. Celebrity Escape to the Country will see our celebrity house hunters explore the serene landscapes and lifestyles of the Home Counties, Cheshire, the Peak District, Lancashire, Kent and Sussex.

name: The Crime I Can't Forget
summary: New true crime series features top detectives who recall the stand-out case that shaped their career. With access to crime scene evidence, compelling archival footage, interviews with victims' families and original investigators, this series unveils both the human impact and intricate process of solving the most complex crimes.

name: Vem dödade Agneta? - Mysteriet i Mistekärr
summary: One autumn day in 2008, 63-year-old Agneta is found beaten to death by a lake in Småland. Suspicion quickly falls on Agneta's husband Ingemar, but is he really guilty? The locals hover in uncertainty until the case takes an unexpected turn, just over a year later. Who killed Agneta?

name: Sveriges musikhistoria
summary: Sweden's history is full of music - it starts with bone flutes, trance dance and mysterious bronze slurs. In the series, we get to know harp-playing Viking chieftains, gold-plated medieval sheet music and begging student singers. But also music spies and forbidden instruments, as well as rhythmic work songs and the origin of the Swedish snap song.

name: Capitalisme américain, le culte de la richesse
summary: Over the course of a gripping story that goes from 1870 to today, "American Capitalism – The Cult of Wealth" tells how a small elite has always justified its hyper-wealth in America. From the powerful philanthropic alibi to the constantly renewed promise of trickle-down, from the myth of the self-made man to the heroic figure of the visionary genius of Silicon Valley, this documentary reveals a grand capitalist narrative that is both immutable and unalterable, and at the same time the shadow of which 722 billionaires and 22 million American millionaires continue to enrich themselves without limit and in complete discretion.

previousepisode.name: Qui veut gagner des milliards ? (1981 à aujourd'hui)

name: Blackadders History
summary: Join Tony Robinson as he reunites with Producer John Lloyd to discuss the history behind the Blackadder series in these exclusive interviews.

previousepisode.name: OTTO live! Das Original - Die Bühnenshow von und mit Otto Waalkes

name: Живите лучшую жизнь
summary: Imagine a life where we are never distracted and have time for everything. Where we work as we always dreamed of, and if we get tired of it, we go back to school. Where we don't just eat to satisfy our hunger, but experience vivid impressions from food. Where casual acquaintances and deep relationships on social networks harmoniously form a diverse social circle. Where the center is not the main place in the city, but the entire city becomes the center of life. In fact, this life is already around us. Which means we can stop imagining it and just start living.

name: A Football Life Origins
summary: The Story of how today's top players made it to the league.

name: Wanneng Lian Ai Zahuo Dian
summary: Shi Ye is a police inspector who has no such interests in things like love and romance. One day, Ye finds himself up against a crafty witch who offers peculiar solutions to love problems. Follow Shi Ye as he tries to solve the mystery of the Love Magic Grocery and its peculiar owner.

name: The Pike County Murders: A Family Massacre
summary: How did it come to pass that eight members of the same family could be brutally murdered execution-style in four different locations in one night by members of another family they called friends? One of largest murder investigations in Ohio's history rips off the veneer of small-town America, exposing an underbelly of violence, pitting family against family, mother against son, and brother against brother in a haunting story of lies, secrets, and betrayal.

name: White Fever
summary: Jane is a cocky Korean-Australian adoptee with a love of hairy white guys – the hairier and whiter the better. When her friends call her out for having a white man fetish she sets out to try and reprogram her libido, reignites a connection with childhood friend, Yu Chang and stumbles into the process of finding out who she really is. From hens' nights to country weddings, moon crystals, "gotcha" days and adoptee dinners, it's a K-Pop-infused, action-packed, wild ride filled with revelations, surprises and a large helping of Asian pop culture.

name: MotorTrend Working From Home
summary: All your favorite MotorTrend hosts are also stuck at home and finally have time to catch up on some personal projects of their own, so we asked them to film what they are doing! Whether its learning new skills, building a new rig to help around the shop, or finally catching up on a project car they have been neglecting for years, they are rolling up their sleeves and taking you into their home workshops for a little slice of their life.

name: Our Interpreter
summary:
Lin Xi who's known as the "witch" in the translation industry reunites with ex-boyfriend Xia Yicheng. Eight years ago, she broke up with him for the sake of fulfilling her mother's wish for her to become a professional interpreter for the United Nations.

Eight years later, Lin Xi has become the youngest chief interpreter at Huasheng while her ex Xiao Yicheng has become the chief technology officer of a communications company, which also makes him her potential client.

In order to land a contract with Xiao Yicheng, Lin Xi has no choice but to keep dealing with him. She helps his company go public and even though it seems that Xiao Yicheng is out to get revenge on Lin Xi, he actually doesn't have the heart to be mean to her. Work rekindles their passionate relationship and Xiao Yicheng gradually comes to understand that reason she broke up with him.
In this satirical comedy, a zany nobleman navigates through family feuds and clashes with peasants in his quest to become Poland's most famous figure.

name: Abyss Dweller
summary: January 1940. Liang Shuo, a Communist underground operative with a head wound, awakened in a snowbound mountain and his memory was gone. Drawn to Shanghai by fragmented clues to reclaim his identity, he'd hunted by Japanese forces. Then the Wang Jingwei regime's 76th Agency identified him as their Operations Director. As Japan and Wang Jingwei's government prepared their "Peace & Prosperity Conference," a group of imprisoned laborers would be sent to the frontlines. The Party launched "Project Abyss" to rescue them, but its operative "Frost" had vanished. Amidst enemy traps, Liang recovered his memory: He was Frost. Now he must secure a decade-old list of Japanese spies, which would be revealed at the conference, and complete the impossible mission...

name: Загадай любовь
summary:
Eleventh-grader Natasha Zueva is in love with geography teacher Anton Vladimirovich, whom high school students affectionately call "Goldie" among themselves. A few weeks before the New Year, Anton Vladimirovich calls Natasha, as the head of the class, and offers everyone to go on vacation to a snow-covered ski resort.

Natasha is in a pleasant anticipation. She doesn't know yet that her life will change a lot in the coming weeks. Seemingly unsociable classmate Timur Makeev will save Natasha from the harassment of her older sister's fiance, Edik, will stand up for the girl more than once, will have time to make a good impression on her family, and also honestly admits that he likes her. The high school student is pleased with Timur's company, but she only loves Gold, right? Or is it just her imagination? Natasha is at a loss, she is facing adult problems and experiences for the first time.

name: Affaires sensibles
summary: For the first time, France Inter, France Télévisions and INA are teaming up to co-produce and bring to France 2 a new magazine: Affaires sensibles.

name: Anh Does Scandinavia
summary: Anh Do, Australia's favourite comedian, travels to Scandinavia and Iceland to find out what makes them officially the happiest people on earth.

name: Anh Does Vietnam
summary: Anh Do's travels through his homeland are a warm and wacky cultural mix from a tour guide with an infectious smile.

name: Anh Does Brazil
summary: See Brazil through the eyes of Australian comedian and best-selling author Anh Do. From Rio to the Amazon and Salvador to São Paulo, Anh brings us his unique take on the people, cuisine, customs and culture of modern-day Brazil. As always, Anh throws himself into the action and this adventure could be his craziest yet.

name: Anh Does Italy
summary: From gondoliers of Venice to pasta nonnas of Bari, comedian Anh Do is on a special quest to experience the best of Italy in this two part series.

name: Dragons of Wonderhatch
summary: Upananta's greatest dragonrider disappears in the middle of a crucial battle. Without him, the world is doomed. The rookie dragonrider, Thaim, goes to find him in another world: a place where flying dragons and adventure only exist in high school student Nagi's dreams.

name: Replacing Chef Chico
summary: When a head chef falls into a coma, it's up to his devoted sous-chef to keep their Filipino fine dining restaurant from closing down.

name: Le Collège Noir
summary: The adventure story follows five youths unravelling the mystery of their missing friend in the mountains of central France, still covered with vast, deep forests to this day.

name: Working for the Enemy: Forced Labour in the Third Reich
summary: In conversations with the children and grandchildren of the victims and perpetrators of forced labour, the series tells a story of reconciliation in modern Europe.

name: Зв'язок
summary: A long-distance comedy that strengthens hearts in times of war.

name: Волонтери
summary: The characters of the series are couples, colleagues and old friends who have united for a common cause - volunteering. They manage to hold meetings, provide for civil and military needs, and resolve relationships, while dealing with any life situations with dignity.

name: Закохай мене, якщо зможеш
summary: The protagonist of the series decides to make some extra money and sets up a profitable, but not entirely legal business. The guy pretends to be a medium and promises people to solve all their problems: to find a missing person, to catch an unfaithful spouse cheating, and even to "bring back luck" to some clients. The business is in great demand, but everything can be ruined when the protagonist's success is noticed by journalist Elia, who specializes in exposing pseudo-magicians. To divert the girl's attention, he will have to develop a rather unusual plan.

name: Hit Parader's No Cover
summary:
No Cover is the only true original music competition show focused on changing the lives of unsigned artists. This series is about discovery, mentorship, hard reality and launching careers. No Cover is created and produced by the music business, not traditional Hollywood studios. We believe this is the show fans and musicians around the world have been waiting around for years to see and it's finally here! NO COVER, NO MERCY! 

No Cover was filmed on location at the legendary Troubadour and Sunset Marquis in West Hollywood, CA. 25 of these original artists will be competing for the top prize, which includes a six figure recording contract with Sumerian Records, representation from United Talent Agency and Shelter Music Group, performance slots at a Danny Wimmer Presents Music Festival, a $10,000 shopping spree from Guitar Center, PLUS! brand new gear from Gibson USA, Mesa Engineering, Ernie Ball, Liquid Death and Discmakers.

name: Supervolcano
summary: Molten lava bulging against the Earth's crust beneath America's Yellowstone Park will explode through with devastating effect - it's just a question of when, say scientists. This factual drama set in the near future depicts such an outcome based on evacuation procedures and predictions by volcanologists and futurologists. The year is 2020 and the world faces the ultimate threat. Not nuclear war or a terrorist attack, but the eruption of a gigantic 'supervolcano' simmering beneath Yellowstone Park. The last eruption of this kind plunged the world into darkness for six years, triggered the last Ice Age and reduced the human population to just 2,000 people. Scientists know that the molten lava bulging against the Earth's crust in Yellowstone will explode; it's just a question of when. This powerful, reality-based thriller explores the environmental, political, economic and social impact of such a cataclysmic event. After witnessing the build-up and devastating climax, viewers are projected into the aftermath: a post-apocalyptic world. Can the human species ever recover? Local news feeds, diary footage, CCTV, family camcorder and real archive footage are simulated in gritty detail, while human drama overlays the factual scenario, shaping events into a compelling experience.

name: Interrogation Cam
summary: Interrogation Cam takes you inside the interrogation rooms of law enforcement agencies around the country. Each episode features incredible, real crime stories and spotlights the techniques used by investigators to uncover the unbelievable truth and bring criminals to justice.

name: HACK Crimes Online
summary: The season initially focuses on Shakti's induction in the cybercrime unit alongside Jigar and Girish, and how they transform into an indomitable force solving extreme cybercrime cases under the tutelage of ACP Ashutosh.

name: Murdoch Mysteries: Nightmare on Queen Street
summary: YOU play the role of a visiting detective assisting Murdoch in a troublesome -- and bloody -- murder investigation. Piece together the clues and crack the case before the killer strikes again.

name: Spaceflight
summary: This 4-part documentary miniseries covers the history of manned and unmanned space-flight, from the late 1800s through the mid-1980s.

name: BravoCon Live with Andy Cohen!
summary: Andy Cohen hosts five special episodes of "BravoCon Live with Andy Cohen!" at The Paris Theater.

name: Tales of Wedding Rings
summary: Sato is a high school boy in love with his best friend Hime, an unearthly beauty from another realm. So when she moves back to her home world to get married, Sato doesn't think twice—he follows her and crashes the wedding. Then, after a kiss from Hime, he suddenly becomes the new groom! But here, Hime is a Ring Princess and her husband is destined to be the Ring King: a hero of immense power.

name: Murdoch Mysteries: Beyond Time
summary: Constables Henry Higgins and Slugger Jackson are watching over the Station House when Jackson brings in a man who had been caught breaking into a factory on Power Street, claiming he needs to stop an assassination by time travelling. But when these claims turn out to be true, and Rebecca James gets transported into the future, they have to race against time to save Rebecca, with the help of a certain government agent.

name: Boom Boom Bruno
summary: Bruno is not just any cop. He is Boom Boom Bruno, the district's cowboy. Everything here is under his control. His criminals, his hookers, his boss. He is thrilled with his new partner Mark - it's up to him to teach this insecure boy to be a real man with balls. When a drag queen is found dead on his turf, however, both Bruno and Mark must fight their own prejudices and meet resistance coming from all sides to solve the case.

name: Сама виновата?
summary:
In 2017, the quiet city of Serpukhov near Moscow finds itself in the center of public attention due to the bloody massacre of Dmitry Grachev over his young wife Margarita, who will be remembered for many years as "the girl whose husband cut off her hands with an axe."

Grachev's carefully designed revenge plan does not include murder — he calculates the time he will devote to torture and bullying, takes into account the minutes needed to get to the hospital. After all, if Rita dies, he will be waiting for a long time, and if he follows the plan, he will be convicted only for causing grievous bodily harm and he will meet his thirtieth birthday at large. The story of "Serpukhov's Othello" is flying around the media in an instant, and journalists begin to hunt for details: what forced Grachev to take such a step and is Rita as innocent as she wants to seem?

name: Bai Wan Tong Ju Ji Hua
summary: Ng Chiu Ming is a carefree and unambitious guy who loves money but doesn't have goals or a direction in life. One day, a famous businesswoman, Ms. Fok, invites him to move into her luxurious house with a few other contestants. Those that survive the six-month period will each receive one million dollars. However, more and more problems surface as time goes by.

name: Les nouvelles aventures de Lucky Luke
summary: Every hero must have a villain, and Lucky Luke has four: the Dalton brothers. Fortunately, he's faster to draw his revolver than his own shadow and he has a loyal friend in his horse.

name: Hoob Phaya Suer
summary: A story about Paen, a handicapped man who has a miraculous life. Sua Prai, a revered good thief helps healing Paen's physical diability and turns him into a strong man. Paen then disguises as a minion of a local mafia to track down the lost land title deed. He also hunts for Praedaeng thief who killed his mother and tries to save Pailin, his loved one, from the son of the mafia. Despite the grave dangers, he never fears. But it hurts him when he learns that Sua Prai and Praedaeng thief are the same person. He then has to choose between repaying his gratitude or seek retribution.

name: Innermost
summary: Three stories intertwine. Innermost immerses us in a complex reality of violence and grace, which rages in today's Tel Aviv under the apparent calm of modernity, and shows us how life makes different destinies intertwine.

name: Hazalemet
summary: The series follows in the footsteps of Anna, a photographer, a few weeks before her death. The women who show up at his studio confront the camera, testifying to their complicated relationship with their own bodies and their deep secrets. Anna pushes them to make changes in their lives. But can she do the same?

name: Kald mig far
summary: Non-confrontational Emil and self-assured Viktor are life-long friends. Having always done everything together, they become business partners when launching a sustainable catering company.

name: Détective Surprenant : la fille aux yeux de pierre
summary: Detective Sergeant Surprenant, a veteran of major crimes in Montreal who took refuge in the Islands, investigates with the help of his colleague Geneviève Savoie and inexperienced police officers, even giving up his vacation to solve this sad story. However, he must deal with the arrogant chief inspector Sébastien Gingras, dispatched from Quebec and with whom he has disagreements.

name: La Fièvre
summary: Soccer star Fodé Thiam goes off the rails in front of the cameras, calling his coach a "dirty toubab" (white in Wolof). Caught up in the media storm, the club calls on Sam Berger, a talented communicator, to manage the crisis. But her rival, Marie Kinsky, was not to be counted out, as she instrumentalized the event by fanning the flames of the identity and social rifts dividing the country. The fever never stops rising.

name: Amar é Para os Fortes
summary: Amar é Para os Fortes tells the story of two mothers in search for justice after a police invasion in their community led to a tragedy that changed the lives of these two families forever. On one hand, Rita deals with the death of her youngest son, Sushi. On the other, Edna, the mother of police officer Digão, faces the consequences of her son's actions during the operation.

name: Murdoch Mysteries: The Murdoch Effect
summary: Detective Murdoch wakes in modern-day Toronto after being accidentally knocked unconscious. Murdoch must try to keep his wits about him as he races against and through time to solve a parallel case in both the 19th and 21st centuries.

name: The King's Guard: Serving the Crown
summary:
This series goes behind the scenes for the first time to the elite regiments of the British Army's Household Division, in one of the busiest years in its 350-year history.

Known as the King‘s Guard' the soldiers serve a dual role. Their sworn duty is to protect the Monarch and the State - as masters of state ceremony and tradition as well as being a modern fighting force. This series enters both worlds with privileged access as the Household Division prepares to serve the Crown in both its "red" (ceremonial) and "green" (combat) roles.

name: Scotland's Weather – Our Changing Seasons
summary: Judith Ralston explores Scotland's changing seasons.

name: JFK: The Final Evidence
summary: The mystery behind the assassination of US President John F Kennedy in November 1963. His family, his foes, and who may have had motive to conspire to kill.

name: Soy tu fan. La fiesta continua
summary: How can one be an adult and not lose the magic? How can one live with love when the best of youth is left behind? This story proposes a reunion with the characters that marked a generation of Mexicans, who are now facing adult life. Together again, Charly and Nicolás embark on the difficult journey of trying to have a baby. Fernanda and Iñaki face the dilemma of getting back together. Meanwhile, Rocío feels that motherhood is crushing her and tries to rediscover her sex life, while Diego obsessively pursues professional success.

name: Hitler's Engineers: Building the Third Reich
summary:
After Germany's defeat in 1945, Hitler's most trusted henchmen tried to downplay their role in the Holocaust and distance themselves from the brutal Nazi regime. But they couldn't hide their misdeeds forever. Charting the lives and careers of the Führer's most prominent planners, designers, architects, and builders, Hitler's Engineers: Building the Third Reich exposes the truth—revealing the active role these men played in shaping the war, fueling anti-Semitism, and convincing everyday Germans to join their sinister cause.

Featuring leading journalists, historians, and academics—and combining science, engineering, and history—the premium six-part series investigates Volkswagen Beetle designer Ferdinand Porsche, infamous architect Albert Speer, aerospace pioneer Wernher von Braun, and more.

name: Comedy Royale
summary: A battle royale of comedy in which twenty representatives of Korean comedy put aside age, experience, and titles in competition for an opportunity to host their own Netflix show.

name: Famous Toastery Bowl
summary: The Famous Toastery Bowl is a postseason NCAA Division I FBS college football bowl game to be played in December 2023. Played at the Jerry Richardson Stadium in Charlotte, North Carolina, the bowl is owned and operated by ESPN Events.

previousepisode.name: The 1st Annual Famous Toastery Bowl: Western Kentucky vs. Old Dominion

name: A Vida Pela Frente
summary: They are young and still have a lot to live for, but we never know what tomorrow will bring... When they lose a classmate, new perspectives touch their hearts.

name: Label
summary: Revolves around the protagonist struggle to reach his desired identity, overcoming the identity society has labelled him with.

name: Your Christmas or Mine
summary: Young student couple James and Hayley both decide to surprise the other at Christmas only to have to accidentally experience Christmas with each other's families. Hayley ends up with James‘s military father, Lord Humphrey The Earl of Gloucester, at his country house. James, on the other hand, ends up with Hayley‘s working class family, in Macclesfield.

name: Boetie Boer: Inside the Mind of a Killer
summary: As Nelson Mandela is released from 27 years in prison (1990), Stewart 'Boetie Boer' Wilken starts his killing spree. Unlike most serial killers, he had more than one type of victim. He also claimed to engage in necrophilia and cannibalism.

name: Lusitânia
summary: A cursed wolf-child, two sisters battling each other to win a castle, a cocky Friar betting against the Devil; these are a few of Lusitania's stories. Lusitania is an anthology of six different tales that recount Iberian legends taken from a vast and rich folklore. This epic series deals in fantasy, horror, comedy and drama, weaving a tapestry of myths and legends.

name: Spinners
summary: Ethan is a good kid born on the wrong side of town. In Cape Town's slums where local gangs make the law, he is soon left with no choice but to work for one of them to support himself and his younger brother. Caught in a web of crime, he discovers he has an incredible talent for spinning, an exciting and extreme motorsport. Could this be his way out from the violent criminal life that seems to be the only option to survive in his neighbourhood?

name: Nada más que la verdad
summary: Nada más que la verdad (Nothing But the Truth) is a game show created by Howard Schultz, an American television producer and owner of Lighthearted Entertainment. It was first aired in Colombia. The hosts asks the contestants a series of 21 increasingly personal and embarrassing questions for a huge jackpot. The format has been exported to 47 countries, and appears in most countries as The Moment of Truth.

name: When a Snail Falls in Love
summary: Vita is a rookie genius in psychological research. Her brain works as if there were a rapid generator in it. In fact, it is a gifted talent as a snail. Upon joining the police force, she is facing the fate of getting removed due to her weak physique. Since Officer Prach is the only one who can help her, Vita tries everything to make Prach take her in as his mentee. As the captain of the Police Investigators Team (PTI), Prach is one of the few brilliant, experienced, and skilled investigators. At first, Prach does not take a liking to Vita. Besides, both are not on the same page regarding how to deal with cases. However, having joined hands and solved a series of cases, Prach begins to fancy this innocent yet witty mentee of his. Alas, Vita, who is as dull as a snail, does not feel Prach's love. When the two of them are talking about love and cases, the spooky serial killer is back. Prach and Vita finally acknowledge their feelings toward one another in the face of danger. Prach has always been bothered by the Luger case, which has reopened. The lovers once again join hands to embark on an extremely menacing journey of catching the criminal.

name: Hunting
summary: The story follows anti-narcotics officer Yang Yipeng, who, after a major police crackdown, seizes the arrest of drug lord Mou Haidong—still resisting even in custody—as a breakthrough point. With the support of rookie officer An and the assistance of informant Duo Zai, Yang traces leads from Mou Sen to the source of a new synthetic drug. Their investigation uncovers sprawling trafficking networks stretching across Hong Kong, southern Hunan, and the Yunnan–Sichuan border region. Yet, the true mastermind behind it all remains hidden in the shadows…

name: Doctor Who
summary: The Doctor and friends travel from the dawn of human history to distant alien worlds. And everywhere they go, they find adventure, terror, fun, chases, joy and monsters.

name: Nothing But the Truth
summary: Prior to the show, contestants are asked to answer a series of questions while connected to a polygraph, but were not informed of the results. During the show, each contestant is again asked up to 21 of the questions they were asked offscreen. A voice-over, or occasionally the host, announced whether the answer is "true" or "false", based on the result of the polygraph test before the show. The contestant may continue after certain milestones and keep the money they have won so far; giving an answer deemed "false" results in the loss of all the money. The top prize in this version was £50,000.

name: We'll Get By
summary: The series revolves around the Platts, an average, middle-class couple who live in New Jersey with their three children, and the events that might occur within any family.

name: A Secretly Love
summary: Khonprot, a third-year head hazer of the engineering faculty, has a secret crush on Pluem, a tsundere fourth-year head hazer. Over the years, he's seen Pluem cycle through many girlfriends. Recently, after a public breakup, however, Khonprot thinks things may be different. How can he succeed if he doesn't dare tell Pluem he'd like to be his favorite person?

name: OMG! Vampire
summary: After waking from a century-long sleep, vampire Phum finds that the land of vampires has banned gen-x vampires from falling in love. The new law doesn't suit Phum and he invites his gang of close friends—Sen, Run, Mix and Jolie—to flee to the land of humans where people have more freedom. Getting there, however, won't be easy. They'll need to put their names down in the Bible of Life and take the bodies of their parallel human selves, mindful that there may be consequences. Phum finds himself living the life of a broken-hearted young man. Life in the land of humans is turning out to be a chaotic undertaking when he meets Patrick, the owner of a secret bar, and ends up working for him.

name: Boate Kiss: A Tragédia de Santa Maria
summary: Marcelo Canellas tells the story of the struggle for justice carried out by relatives of the victims of one of the greatest tragedies in Brazil: the fire at the Kiss nightclub.

name: A Magia de Aruna
summary: A Magia de Aruna is set in a world that is going through a solar crisis. In it, a gray Rio de Janeiro is the place where young Mima lives. She is a teenager who does everything she can to hide her strange power of hyper empathy in a world that is apart from magic. However, when participating in an important competition, Mima ends up facing a challenge that makes her lose control of this mysterious gift. As she walks away from her companions, the young woman reveals a spell performed 300 years ago. And with that, she will wake up three Guardian Witches.

name: Acampamento de Magia para Jovens Bruxos
summary: Camp Luminum has its portals open and Berenice is ready to make new friends, settle down with her crush and improve her powers. She just didn't count on a big mystery on the way.

name: 8 Presidentes 1 Juramento
summary: The mini series is a collage and comentary of varied third party footage on news relating to each and every one of the eight Presidents of Brazil who took office since the end of the military government, from José Sarney to Jair Bolsonaro.

name: A Mão do Eurico
summary: No top hat was more loved and hated than him. Eurico Miranda collected titles, a lot of criticism and became the most controversial manager in the history of Brazilian football.

name: Stags
summary: Stags follows groom-to-be Stu and his friends on his stag do in South America. What was meant to be a week of drink, debauchery and fun takes a dark turn. Instead of boarding a flight back to the UK, the stags are sent to a lawless prison island run by two warring siblings.Quickly it becomes clear that the stags need to pick a side to have any chance of survival. Friendships are tested and life-long loyalty is sacrificed as Stu and his mates begin to question who will make it home alive.

name: Sanningen
summary: Iris Broman is the new manager of the Kalla Fall group in Malmö. She has just broken up from her old life in Stockholm and moved into her half-sister's house by the sea in Ystad. On the same day that Iris starts her new job, a skull is found in the forest.

name: Прощай, Легенда
summary: Five comedians in different characters came to say goodbye to the legend

name: Olivia Attwood: The Price of Perfection
summary:
Olivia will investigate the high-risk nature of going under the knife and the jeopardy that comes with any procedure, as well as the eye-watering amount of money some are willing to spend on their dream appearance.

Olivia asks beyond the price tag what are the potential human costs of surgery and gets up close and personal with cosmetic surgery's winners and losers.

name: Alles finster
summary: From the cell phone to the refrigerator, from the lamp to the toilet flush - nothing works anymore. Not even in the small village of Kekenberg on the Della, where panic and chaos soon threaten to break out. Because it quickly turns out that when it comes to survival, we're all pretty badass these days.

name: Blue Submarine No. 6
summary: The once famous and well respected scientist Zorndyke has bred a new genre of living being, one that thrives on the oceans and lives to destroy humans. Zorndyke believes it is time that the humans were relieved of their rule of the earth. It is up to Blue Submarine No. 6 and the rest of the Blue fleet to put an end to Zorndyke's madness and creations.

name: Вина України
summary:
Ukraine has its own wine and it is incredible. And we know very little about it. The history of Ukrainian winemaking stretches back to antiquity, and maybe even further. Having survived the Soviets with their anti-alcohol campaign and massive vineyard cutting, Ukrainian winemaking is actively developing. Since regaining independence, new vineyards have been planted, new wineries have emerged to experiment with wine styles and grape varieties, and our wines have won more and more awards at international competitions and blind tastings.
The Wines of Ukraine series will show you local grape varieties, the best terroirs of different regions of Ukraine, traditional and new experimental wines. And most importantly, the project will tell you about the people behind modern Ukrainian winemaking and their journey to wine.

previousepisode.name: Виноробство Галичини: дикі дріжджі, плодово-ягідне вино й виноград української селекції

name: Як ми збираємо мільйони
summary:
The full-scale war that Russia launched against Ukraine has been going on for over a year now. However, Ukrainians continue to contribute to the army's needs, despite the financial difficulties that came with the war. Everyone understands that the war is on and that the army, which protects us from the enemy, needs help.
Today, creative fundraising for the army is developing especially fast and interesting: what Ukrainians can come up with to help our military! These fundraisers are driven by people working in the cultural and other creative fields. They use their skills and connections to raise funds for the army. 
In the How We Raise Millions project, we talk about creative ways to raise funds for the army.

previousepisode.name: Наріман Алієв: благодійні покази, аукціони й пісні Іво Бобула за донат на ЗСУ

name: Підрозділи перемоги
summary: A documentary series about military units defending Ukraine and bringing victory in the Russian-Ukrainian war closer.

previousepisode.name: Начальник штабу бригади у 26 років. Лев Пашко (Хорус) з Азову

name: Культура під час війни
summary: Find out more about how culture and traditions change in times of war and how artists reflect on the events in their works in this documentary series.

previousepisode.name: Одеський музей, бесарабський фестиваль і «Мельпомена Таврії»

name: Свідки
summary: "Witnesses" is a documentary series created from interviews that the War Archive team has been collecting since 2022. These are the stories of five brave residents of settlements north of Kyiv (Moshchun, Yasnohorodka, Borodyanka) who survived the Russian occupation but never stopped resisting. Delivering humanitarian aid, rescuing our soldiers from encirclement, providing medical care, cooking for soldiers or just for cats - all these are big and small personal feats that inspire and give us strength to continue the fight.

previousepisode.name: Дулі проти дронів, полон та втеча — опір окупації на Поліссі

name: What Drives You with John Cena
summary: John Cena is known for his award-winning performances in the ring and on the big screen, but now this global icon is ready to give audiences a front row seat to his two biggest passions: cars and connecting with people. What Drives You is a breakthrough talk format where John will spend time with the most successful celebrities on the planet and talk about what drives them—both on the road and in their hearts.

previousepisode.name: Charlotte Flair: Queen of the Ring
